description: Turn ANY topic — or a slide deck — into a narrated explainer short video, automatically: researches the topic, writes and voices the script, designs and builds the visuals (cinematic Remotion tier or HTML pages; a deck's slides full-frame with gentle motion and timed callouts) and burns in captions.
